> Besonders geeignet beim Wachsausschmelzverfahren für Hinterschneidungen, Windungen, Gewinde sowie sehr komplexe Geometrien.

About Schwarz Präzisionskeramik
Schwarz Präzisionskeramik has been operating in the ceramic core business sphere as an independent company, since 2003. The company emerged from the former “ceramic core” department of FEINGUSS BLANK GmbH, as an independent undertaking. 
Schwarz Präzisionskeramik specialises in the manufacture of ceramic cores for the production of cast products. Due to the high quality, performance and customer satisfaction Schwarz Präzisionskeramik is experimenting a significant growth projecting their operations and markets not only to serve the market of Germany but also the European Market
